purpose: Form MDC-2 is used to apply to the Central Government, the Tribunal, or the Appellate Tribunal for referring a matter pertaining to a pending proceeding for mediation or conciliation.
who: Parties concerned in a pending proceeding
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the application in Form MDC-2 for referring a pending matter for mediation or conciliation.
Include the required fee of one thousand rupees with the application.
Submit the application to the Central Government, the Tribunal, or the Appellate Tribunal where the proceeding is pending.
Wait for the Central Government, Tribunal, or Appellate Tribunal to appoint one or more experts from the panel upon receipt of the application.
checklist: Ensure the matter pertains to a proceeding pending before the Central Government, the Tribunal, or the Appellate Tribunal.
Prepare the application in Form MDC-2.
Arrange the fee of one thousand rupees to accompany the application.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
